summary.scope: V21 backtest Exness BTCUSD ETHUSD 2025-01 through 2026-10
summary.rules: Sequential top-half filter; odd input size keep ceil(n/2). Stage1 rank by cumulative modeled portfolio BP; stage2 rank survivors by sum of 4 independent bot trade counts across 22 months. Tie stage1 min_month_bp; tie stage2 total_bp; then ID.
summary.costs: Historical Bid/Ask spread + 1bp slippage each side; excludes overnight swaps, commission and live execution costs.
summary.profit_units: sum of monthly portfolio basis points on fixed notional; no compounding
